prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def largest_rect(c):
        heights = [0]*w
        best = (0, None)
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                heights[j] = heights[j]+1 if grid[i][j]==c else 0
            st = []
            for j in range(w+1):
                cur = heights[j] if j < w else 0
                start = j
                while st and st[-1][1] >= cur:
                    s, hh = st.pop()
                    area = hh*(j-s)
                    if area > best[0]:
                        best = (area, (hh, j-s, i-hh+1, s))
                    start = s
                st.append((start, cur))
        return best
    cands = [v for v in set(x for r in grid for x in r) if v]
    scored = sorted(((largest_rect(c)[0], c) for c in cands), reverse=True)
    color = scored[0][1]
    hh, ww, i0, j0 = largest_rect(color)[1]
    side = max(hh, ww) - 2
    return [[color]*side for _ in range(side)]
'''

prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def largest_rect(c):
        heights = [0]*w
        best = 0
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                heights[j] = heights[j]+1 if grid[i][j]==c else 0
            st = []
            for j in range(w+1):
                cur = heights[j] if j < w else 0
                start = j
                while st and st[-1][1] >= cur:
                    s, hh = st.pop()
                    best = max(best, hh*(j-s))
                    start = s
                st.append((start, cur))
        return best
    cands = sorted({x for r in grid for x in r if x})
    color = max(cands, key=lambda c: (largest_rect(c), sum(r.count(c) for r in grid)))
    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
